UPDATED 13 NOV 2026 - RFQ AMENDMENT #4 to update RFQ Package and Extend the Bid Deadline FROM 16 NOV 2026 TO 27 NOV 2026    

 1. The following RFQ Package documents are updated and/or added as follows: 

 
	 RFQ Document, titled “26Q0012_0_RFQ_13 Nov 26”. 
	 Attachment 1, Statement of Work, titled “26Q0012_Attch 1_SOW_13 Nov 26”. 
	 Attachment 2, Clauses & Provisions, titled “26Q0012_Attch 2_Clauses_28 Oct 26”. 
	 Attachment 3, Hotel Attestation, titled “26Q0012_Attch 3_Hotel Attestation_29 Oct 26”. 
	 Attachment 4, Pricing Schedule, titled “26Q0012_Attch 4_Pricing Schedule_3 Nov 26”. 
	 Attachment 5, Government answers to Q&A, titled “26Q0012_Attch 5_Q.A GOVERNMENT_Repsonses_13 Nov 2026”. 
	 Attachment 6, Dept of Labor Wage Determination, titled “26Q0012_Attch 6_DOL WD” – NOTE: The body of the document was not changed – only the title to match the RFQ number. 
	 NEW Attachment 7, Hotel Polaris Layout, titled “26Q0012_Attch 7_Hotel Polaris Layout_13 Nov 26”. 
 

 2.  The Bid Deadline is hereby updated to  4:00 PM ET FRIDAY, 27 NOVEMBER 2026.  

 3.  It should be noted that significant changes have been made to the requirements package documents to address vendor Q&A. As such, any bidder who has already submitted a quote is encouraged to review the changes and provide an updated bid to conform to the updated technical requirements. 

 4.  It should also be noted that Attachment 5, Question #26, refers to possible streaming and video requirements. The Requirements Owner is currently reviewing their needs for camera equipment and may issue a subsequent RFQ amendment to include those added tasks. Those tasks are NOT included at this time, and they may not be included in future amendments. Please check SAM.gov for updates. 

 5.  No other documents, terms, or conditions of this RFQ are revised or changed as a result of this amendment.
